mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 4.8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic weakness that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), CPIAUCSL above 2.5% annually signals persistent inflation, increasing real rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of tightening cycles with CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate dual sector stress that reduces overall economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 > 11000), a quarterly GDP level below 11200 billion signals economic deceleration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (GDPC1 < 11200 during late-cycle), or Rank IC < 0.03.
